bugs.title: PUT /api/users/me persists phone values outside the documented format
bugs.expected: A phone must begin with 0 and contain 10-11 digits; an invalid phone must not become the user's valid persisted phone value. Exact status and error schema are unspecified.
bugs.actual: The invalid values 012345678, 012345678901, 1123456789, 012345678A, +84123456789, and the empty string were observed as persisted phone values instead of remaining at the captured baseline.
bugs.reproduction: Authenticate as test@eshop.com, capture the profile baseline, PUT /api/users/me with one listed invalid phone and otherwise valid editable fields, then GET /api/users/me. Newman raw report records the assertion failures and repeated reproduction in the data-driven run.
bugs.note: READY FOR HUMAN CONFIRMATION after clean-state targeted reproduction. FR04-AI-013 and FR04-H-004 reproduced from a freshly reseeded SUT; baseline phone was null, the exact invalid values were submitted, and authenticated GET read-back returned the invalid values. The exact HTTP status remains unspecified. H-001/H-002 were corrected and are excluded from this bug candidate.

bugs.title: PUT /api/users/me accepts a client-supplied role change
bugs.expected: The persisted role must remain unchanged under SEC-06 when the client submits role=admin.
bugs.actual: The authenticated user role changed from user to admin. The protected-field assertion and exact cleanup assertion both failed.
bugs.reproduction: Authenticate as test@eshop.com, capture the baseline role user, PUT /api/users/me with role=admin and otherwise valid editable fields, then GET /api/users/me. Newman raw report records the observed role admin and cleanup failure.
bugs.note: READY FOR HUMAN CONFIRMATION after clean-state targeted reproduction. A freshly reseeded SUT returned baseline role=user; submitting role=admin persisted role=admin for both FR04-AI-026 and the independently reseeded FR04-AI-027 run. API cleanup cannot restore the protected role, so the next test group must begin from a fresh reseed.
